summary: The trace validates the existing workload-capacity-planning skill as working correctly. The agent successfully followed the skill's workflow, detected the vertical Excel layout, handled the initial state correctly, and validated outputs. However, the trace reveals two patterns worth capturing: (1) the agent briefly attempted pandas before falling back to openpyxl as the skill directs, and (2) an interesting edge case where the first 4-day week (Week 23) occurred before the first 5-day week (Week 24) due to demand patterns. Minor clarifications added to SKILL.md and validation checklist to reinforce openpyxl preference and document out-of-order step-down transitions.
